description: CanadaBuys returned an official new-notice export, and the committed screen found no matches in three records. That result supports closing the three-record screen and checking the separate open-notice export once for a current paid purchase. Catalogue publication depends on host-confirmed independent approval of the exact candidate and an eligible publisher. An eligible inquiry can proceed through the existing private route independently of that revision. Five unclassified feedback sources leave demand unknown, and Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue.
